_comment: The curated category-fund menu (ENG-033, D16): 5-8 funds, steward-published, never
free text. A registry entry's `impact_category_defaults` slugs resolve ONLY against
this menu; an unknown slug is a validation failure, not a warning.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: {ORG}/spec publishes the machine-readable menu. This file is the
self-contained vendored copy this repo validates against, and
scripts/validate-registry.mjs asserts that the `slug` set here is EQUAL to the enum
in schema/registry-entry.v1.json — the two cannot drift apart silently.
PROVISIONAL: the fund set, its names, and its baskets are Schedule-owned and are not
settled. `provisional: true` marks that; flip it to false only when the Schedule
